title: LR-196
author: Jeremiah 29:11, 12, 14
snippet: The Lord said: I think thoughts of peace and not of affliction. You will call upon me, and I will answer you, and I will lead back your captives from every place.

title: Responsorial Psalm - 33rd Sunday OT
author: (Psalm 128: 1-2, 3, 4-5)
snippet: Blessed are those who fear the Lord.

title: Gospel Acclamation
author: John 15:4a, 5b
snippet: Remain in Me As I Remain in You, Says the Lord. Whoever Remains in Me Will Bear Much Fruit.

title: Parable
author: M.D. Ridge
snippet: To ev'rything there is a season; a time to be born and a time to die. A time to plant and a time for harvest; a time to meet and a time to part. A sower went out to sow the seed. Some of it fell upon the path, some fell on shallow, rocky soil, and some among choking thorns.

title: Sanctuary
author: John W. Thompson, Randy Scruggs
snippet: Lord, prepare me to be a sanctuary; pure and holy; tried and true. With thanksgiving; I'll be a living Sanctuary for You.

title: Taste and See
author: Bob Hurd
snippet: Taste and see, O taste and see, taste and see the goodness of God.

title: Peace
author: Gregory Norbet / Weston Priory
snippet: Peace I leave with you, my friends, peace the world cannot give. Peace I leave with you, my friends, so that your joy be ever full.

title: 10,000 Reasons (Bless the Lord)
author: Jonas Myrin / Matt Redman
snippet: Bless the Lord, O my soul, O my soul; worship his holy name. Sing like never before, O my soul; I’ll worship your holy name.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Lord, have mercy. Christ have mercy. Lord have mercy

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Glory to God! Glory to God in the highest, and on earth, peace to people of goodwill.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Holy, holy, holy Lord God of hosts. Heaven and earth are full of your glory. Hosanna in the highest. Blessed is he who comes in the moment of the Lord. Hosanna in the highest.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: When we eat this bread and drink this cup, we proclaim your death, O Lord, until you come again.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Lamb of God, You take away the sins of the world; have mercy, have mercy on us.
